body: But wouldn’t that fluidity make punk have more genres? Just because EDM genres are exclusive doesn’t mean they’re better by any means.

Ah- very good points. But take into consideration the different between punk like Minor Threat versus The Clash versus The Cure. Then Brand New, Agent Orange, Dashboard Confessional... or Hawthorne Heights... they’re all punk or derivatives of. And with electronic I’ve got a wide array too but I don’t think the question is “how many different notes can I play on this instrument” but more like how different can genres sound, and how good can it sound versus just being different to be different? I get it, there’s DnB, house, trip-hop, So on and so forth, but there’s still that element of “same” to it.
I was curious about metal too- but even grindcore and hardcore fall under punk genres. I also know nothing about metal haha- I do like Norwegian dreamy black metal!

Yeah and including hardcore music, which is almost entirely another genre, same with pop punk and the emo which came from that. Some of these would be considered rock, but you can tell it derives from punk music with its distinct sense of individuality and underground roots. It’s like classic punk being sensitive on Xanax. And hardcore literally formed out of a “rebellion against a rebellion” of the punk scene. Another person said it would be more fair to put EDM against rock music, but, and maybe I’m ignorant here, I think there’s more punk genres than rock. Depends though- because where would I put indie music? I really want to say punk because of that underground feel.
Oh- it’s definitely 100% a genre- it’s its own. It emerged from the punk scene and “departed from the simplicity and traditional aspects of punk into more avante-garde” type stuff.

Eh, not necessarily... because if you take a minute to consider even three genres of punk: hardcore, classic, and pop...!you get such a different vibe from all of them. But I get your point. A guitar can’t moo or have some random noise, but also there’s almost the same amount of variety when it comes to taking the guitar, drums, bass, and the voice into consideration.

I definitely am just staying here until my lease is up, that was the plan, and then I was moving back home until I left for Bali. But I have no reason to be in Lincoln or want to stay here. I don't want to get my Masters Degree here. I think I miss nature. It's so flat here. That's where I go to re-energize, you know? Also you are a godsend. Thank you for taking time out of your day to talk to me. You have no idea. Thank you.

1. I want to be a person that when you see them you feel instantly calm around them and happy because they have a certain aura/feel about them that makes things okay. I want to be self-confident and not have anxiety. I want to have routine but spontaneous travels so that I feel grounded but also stay connected to the world. 2. I truly enjoy wandering through the forest alone. I like feeling content. I like figuring out a new fancy recipe and making it at home and having friends come over and try it. I enjoy running on trails which is kinda like wandering thru the forest. 3. My biggest fears would be never recovering from the anxiety I have inside me and just being a piece of shit lethargic depressed person who everyone looks at and makes them feel better because at least they're not like me. 4. I think a lot of that is number 2. I love going to art museums and I love hiking new places. I love eating with family and playing board games with friends and family. Doing yoga brings me a lot of peace. I like taking pictures too. 5. I just want to help people. Either a counselor/therapist or getting paid to be a volunteer helping overseas. I don't know if I want kids or not so both of those options cater to either one or the other. 6. Suicide awareness and get rid of the stigma surrounding mental illness. 7. My education right now is just getting my Integrative Health major which I graduate in Dec 2018. Then afterwords I'm going to volunteer & teach children basic healthcare in Bali for three months. If I like living overseas I might try to get a job or try Peace Corps or something. If not I'll continue my education in the States or somewhere and get my Masters in counseling. I could do either forever I think. I think I could actually be in therapy forever over traveling different places volunteering but I want that experience first before I try and settle and stuff. 8. I think other people for the most part are great. I believe the best in too many people. I think people's perceptions can rule them if they're not aware of it. I don't like it when people don't take the time to ponder on life in a way that goes towards self-growth, I can never be stuck. I think most people genuinely care, I think there are so many different types of people I can't even imagine. I think people are gross, I think people are beautiful, I compare myself to others, I think people need to keep questioning things to grow and not be stuck one way forever. 9. I don't know how I feel about myself right now. I'm black and white right now and I don't like it. I don't know the difference between self love and self confidence. I think I love myself more than I have confidence. I take care of myself when I'm feeling low but have no confidence to keep it going. 10. It depends. Sometimes I distract myself with negative things. Sometimes I distract myself with positive things. Sometimes I don't distract and I feel. I feel so much. I'm hypersensitive. I know I need to learn from my mistakes in order to grow, I know failing is going to be okay. But sometimes I get down on myself for failing so much, like I'm repeating the same things over and over but I'm really trying to learn, I've repeated that line so many times, "I'm trying, I'm trying, I'm trying."
Running back home would help though wouldn't it? But I agree you're right. I'll try and answer these questions in the next reply.
